issue.title: Worker hangs on shutdown
issue.body: Worker hangs while closing an active database transaction during shutdown.

candidates.title: Worker hangs at startup
candidates.body: Worker hangs at startup while authenticating to the queue.

candidates.title: Transaction prevents shutdown
candidates.body: Shutdown waits forever when a database transaction is active.
